assumptions: Example budget, not an actual purchased deployment or a performance guarantee on DigitalOcean.
One Basic Regular 4-vCPU/8-GiB Droplet hosts both app and PostgreSQL; its 160-GiB disk must fit database, local media, images, logs, temporary dumps, and free space.
10 editors and 50k or 100k entries incur no software seat or total-entry fee. Resource use depends on fields, revisions, media, traffic, and retention.
Assume 50 GiB local media, 500 GiB monthly compute transfer, and 100 GiB off-host object storage for retained application backups with 100 GiB object transfer. Adjust these inputs to measured needs.
Weekly platform snapshots cost 20% of compute. They do not replace matched application database/media backups or prove an acceptable recovery point.
Assume two operator hours monthly at $50/hour. This is a budgeting choice, not measured maintenance time; initial setup, incidents, development, and migration labor are extra.
Frontend hosting, taxes, domain registration/renewal, paid monitoring, optional managed database, and high availability are excluded and must be added to other_monthly_usd when needed.
Cloud quotes are separate from the local Docker Desktop benchmark. No equivalence between local capped containers and the cloud VM is claimed.
